verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a recruiting/ATS platform, since self-hostable ATS products exist. Nothing in the evidence shows Ashby offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment; it is presented only as a hosted all-in-one SaaS platform. The 'host your own careers page' API covers a front-end page fed by Ashby data, not self-hosting the core product.
